patch.value: Adopt Vitest 5 after CodSpeed supports its peer contract

Own the Vitest 5.0.0 and @vitest/coverage-v8 5.0.0 major pair separately from routine dependency refreshes. The repository's mandatory @codspeed/vitest-plugin 5.7.1 currently declares vitest ^3.2 || ^4, so adopting Vitest 5 would violate the installed performance-gate peer contract.

A current @codspeed/vitest-plugin release accepts Vitest 5; Vitest and coverage-v8 are upgraded as an exact compatible pair; CodSpeed, full exact coverage, cross-platform CI, typecheck, static quality, packed consumers, and vulnerability gates pass.

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Duplicate-check evidence: complete all-status PM searches for Vitest 5, Vitest major, and CodSpeed peer compatibility found the closed compatible Vitest 4.1.11 refresh pm-n5ysuk and CodSpeed adoption pm-yh6t, but no owner for the 5.0.0 major. Live registry evidence on 2026-09-04: vitest 5.0.0 supports Node ^22.12 || ^24 || >=26, but mandatory @codspeed/vitest-plugin 5.7.1 declares peer vitest ^3.2 || ^4. This item remains open and unclaimed until that external peer contract is compatible.
